title: DetouR: Plugging Association Routes into Search Agents for Multi-hop Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.19967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Search agents answer multi-hop questions by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, deciding at each step what to search next. Existing agents follow semantic routes: they infer what is missing and phrase it as a query, reaching only what the model can name. Yet the decisive page is often one the question never names, frequently just one hyperlink away from evidence already retrieved. Following such association routes reaches more gold pages than semantic search under the same budget. Exploiting them raises two challenges: obtaining the association structure without costly offline graph construction, and keeping linked evidence in the reader's limited context, where relevance- and fusion-based selection discards it. We propose DetouR, a plug-in that reuses the links arriving with retrieved pages and adds no search or LLM call. Link Rerouting replaces near-repeat queries with routes to linked pages, chosen by a lightweight learned scorer;

translated_title: DetouR：将关联路径嵌入搜索智能体以实现多跳问答
translated_abstract: 搜索智能体通过交替进行推理与检索来回答多跳问题，在每一步决定接下来搜索什么。现有的智能体遵循语义路径：它们推断缺失的信息并将其表述为查询，因而只能到达模型能够明确命名的内容。然而，决定性的页面往往是问题从未提及的页面，且常常距离已检索到的证据仅一个超链接之遥。在相同预算下，遵循这种关联路径比语义搜索能够到达更多的黄金页面（gold pages）。利用这些关联路径带来两个挑战：如何在不进行昂贵的离线图构建的情况下获得关联结构，以及如何在阅读器有限的上下文中保留链接的证据——基于相关性或融合的选择机制会将其丢弃。我们提出了 DetouR，这是一个即插即用的插件，它复用随检索页面一同返回的链接，不增加任何额外的搜索或 LLM 调用。链接重路由机制用指向链接页面的路径替代近似重复的查询，这些路径由一个轻量级的可学习评分器来选择；
tldr: DetouR 提出一种即插即用插件，通过复用已检索页面自带的超链接进行“链接重路由”，在不增加任何搜索或 LLM 调用的情况下引导搜索智能体沿关联路径找到问题未直接提及的关键证据，从而提升多跳问答性能。
en_tdlr: DetouR is a plug-in that reuses hyperlinks arriving with retrieved pages via lightweight "Link Rerouting", guiding search agents along association routes to reach decisive yet unmentioned pages without extra search or LLM calls, thereby improving multi-hop question answering.
